title: G2.1 - Versioned Agent lifecycle
intent: Make governed, version-bound Agent identity the only native production execution identity.
scope: Implement Workspace-scoped AgentDefinition, immutable AgentVersion, versioned Deployment, basic EvaluationRun, default Deployment resolution, native graph and Run identity binding, and the corresponding Agents UI.
non_goals: Implement the full Runner, RunAttempt, IntegrationAttempt, Connector, Artifact, Evidence, Submission, DeliveryReview, or Acceptance lifecycle
Remove inherited Paperclip agents or their compatibility APIs
Grant implicit capabilities or let an Agent approve its own release or deployment
Approve, merge, deploy, release, or create a ship record without independent review and explicit user acceptance
acceptance_criteria: DB, shared, Go Domain API, TypeScript facade, and UI expose synchronized Workspace-scoped lifecycle contracts.
Publishing an AgentDefinition creates an immutable, content-addressed, monotonically numbered AgentVersion.
EvaluationRun fixes candidate and baseline versions, records quality, cost, latency, and safety results, and gates production activation.
Deployment changes create immutable revisions; default resolution is unique; pause, resume, and rollback are audited.
Native graph responsibility and Agent Run creation resolve to an active DeploymentRevision and fixed AgentVersion rather than arbitrary IDs.
The Agents surface supports definition, publish, evaluation, deployment, pause, resume, and rollback workflows with visible failures.
Fresh and upgrade migrations, focused tests, typecheck, build, Go tests, token gates, and browser acceptance pass with inspectable evidence.
